name: Long Live the Queen
description: Our landing has confirmed both our rumors and fears.  With the death of my father, Erathia's lands are being greedily divided by her neighbors.

name: Dungeons and Devils
description: Erathian history has never recorded the fall of Steadwick to her enemies.  Today we start a glorious campaign to forever change this fact.  No longer will we allow Erathia to hamper our religious and economic ways of life.  We have the element of surprise.  We will soon have victory as well.

name: Spoils of War
description: In times of strife, your mercenary ways will earn you great rewards.  With Erathia collapsing under the weight of the Nighon onslaught in the east, the opportunity for some land grabbing has presented itself in the west.  Erathia's lands are ours for the taking.

name: Liberation
description: We have established a solid foothold in Erathia, but the nation lies in near ruin.  We start lby freeing the capitol city of Steadwick, and we do not stop until every invader has been driven from our lands.

name: Long Live the King
description: The war in Erathia is the greatest thing that could have happened for the nation of Deyja.  A war of this scale is an endless harvest for our undead armies.  Today we shall feast, and tomorrow we shall conquer Erathia for ourselves.

name: Song for the Father
description: The final step in the Restoration of Erathia is to drive the Necormancers of Deyja back in to their barren homeland.  With the ressurrected body of King Gryphonheart leading them, this will prove to be a formidable task.

name: Seeds of Discontent
description: With the invaders finally driven out of the Contested Lands, the time has come to rebuild.  But one man, Faruk Wlenin, has chosen to free the Contested Lands from Erathia and AvLee forever.

name: New Beginning
description: Gem arrives from Enroth fresh from the Succession Wars.  She first helps the Clovergreen Militia and then aids a wizard's apprentice against the Necromancers of Deyja.

name: Elixir of Life
description: Gelu has spent many months training to become a member of Erathia's elite Forest Guard.  For his final test, he is tasked to assemble an artifact known as the Elixir of Life.  He must find the artifact's four components to keep it out of the hands of the Necromancers.

name: Hack and Slash
description: Crag Hack, newly arrived in Erathia and looking for adventure, meets a young wizard named Sandro, who hires him to find the four pieces of the Armor of the Damned so he can destroy the cursed thing.  Great rewards are offered for this service.

name: Birth of a Barbarian
description: Yog has been at the Bracada magic academy learning to be a Wizard, but his Barbarian heritage beckons him to follow the path of a warrior.  Yog accepts Duke Winston Boragus' offer to join him in Krewlod.  Unfortunately, the Wizards of Bracada will use all their powers to prevent him from leaving.

name: Rise of the Necromancer
description: Sandro must fight his way past his old master and several other lords who want the artifacts he carries.  Once in Deyja he will make allies and soon rise to the top of the Deyja hierarchy.

name: Unholy Alliance
description: Four heroes must uncover the plot brewing on the AvLee-Deyjan border and the Erathian-Deyjan border.  From there they must find the Angelic Alliance, invade Deyja and stop Sandro, the powerful lich who plans to conquer the world.

name: Specter of Power
description: Sandro's first attempt at conquering Antagarich has failed.  However, he is not defeated.  Sandro will pull together several groups of people and start the first rumblings of war that will engulf all of Antagarich.
